person_note: The base narration is third person with focalization shifting among characters. The diagnostic Goodreads passage about Salander agrees with two distinct sustained interior excerpts: one follows Salander and one follows Wrange, both externally in third person. The whole-book POV description independently confirms third person despite chapter-level focal shifts. q02492's isolated I remains locally unresolved: the book-level THIRD evidence cannot establish its missing immediate framing. No credible source indicated sustained first- or second-person base narration; the only residual uncertainty is the missing immediate context of that isolated line, which does not affect the book-level result. Quote audit: q02492 is unclear rather than presumed non_base.
